profile_headline: Hiring IoT Developer and Technical Trainers
post_content:
As a edutech startup we are working few products related to AI which will help
to bring change in our education sector. We thought to hire few interns which
can help them to have real time work experience with stipend based on their
performance. As a startup we thought to give 5k and if performance is good
upto 10k stipend and with full time job opportunity after internship. My post
got more response and around 110 students applied me and my team felt good by
seeing the resumes. Once we start interviewing them we shocked with their
answers. Max number of students are pursuing their graduation and are in final
semester ... They are asking stipend minimum of 20k to 50k per month. I know
few MNCs like Wipro and TCS pay 15k as stipend after training. Is really
companies paying 20k to 50k as stipend. Guys please let me know what is the
real situation in market. Is really for AI and ML inters companies paying that
much amount as stipend. Amrita Angappa Ankit Rathi Ashi Singhal Yogesh Kothiya
